newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound Lines Feb sales rise 11.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound Lines Feb sales rise 11.9 pct.

text.p: Greyhound Lines Inc said Thursday its sales for February increased 11.9 percent, to $29.4 million from $26.3 million in February 1996.
Greyhound said a stable competitive environment, increased advertising, and promotional pricing aided its results in the month.
Also, last year's results were hurt by severe weather, Greyhound said.
The number of sales per passenger mile fell 3.4 percent in February, to $0.0887, due to a higher number of longer trips as well as promotional pricing, it said.
